result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the promotional banner has a clear rendering defect: its headline and subtext are nearly invisible against the light green background. No other visual breakage was found beyond expected carousel/viewport clipping.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is rendered in white/very light color on a pale mint-green background, making it nearly unreadable and failing color contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the light banner, or darken the banner background so the white text meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
